name: THE BOUNDARY MAN
awaitingArt: townspeople-110 (art/staging/caps.json; reference/townspeople/brief.md). Not cast in any room until his sheet is cut and this field is removed.
note: Doc 07 #2 and #3, the one doc 07 marks A (Clement, by B's R_BORDERS_MOTT). The two have argued about the same forty feet for six years; they stand in the middle of the street, facing each other. TALK TO either opens the one tree, and they answer alternately (errata 110).
greetsWithBarkNote: As the card sharp: TALK TO opens with the pair's bark for the current reputation, in both voices.

R_SWINDLED.speaker: boundary_b
R_SWINDLED.line: Sold you Claim Two? Ha! That's not even disputed.

R_RACCOON.speaker: boundary_a
R_RACCOON.line: At least yours has an animal on it.

R_SURVEYED.speaker: boundary_a
R_SURVEYED.line: Don't. Don't put ideas in it.

R_LOST_DUEL.speaker: boundary_b
R_LOST_DUEL.line: We could've told you not to duel Vessel.
